SOUTH CAROLINA
STATE HIGHWAY DEPARTMENT
COLUMBIA, S. C. 29202
October 8, 1975
Federal Power Commission 730 Peachtree Building Room 200 Atlanta, Georgia 30308
RE: PWR-LP
Project No. 2740-South Carolina Duke Power Company
Gentlemen:
We have reviewed your draft environmental impact statement for the Bad Creek project, number 2740 in South Larolina. We have no environmental comments, as such, to offer but would like to call your attention to several items mentioned in your EIS.
We understand that an approximate 0.4-mile section of secondary system Road S-171 on the western boarder of the proposed project will have to be relocated. We, of course, would like assurance that this work will be carried out in complete cooperation with the Highway Department. We also understand from the impact statement that an approximate four-mile long access road will have to be constructed which would connect with Route 171. The impact statement is unclear as to whose responsibility it will be for construction and maintenance of the new access road or temporary roads planned in the area.
See revised Table 1-1 and Section 9.
We do not anticipate that the new transmission line which will cross both S. C. Route 11 and S. C. 183 will have an adverse impact on the traffic-carrying functions of these two facilities, but we would expect close coordination with the Highway Department during construction to assure that any disruption in these activities would be minimized.
See revised Section 9.
We appreciate this opportunity to comment on your EIS.
Sincerely your
Paul W. Cobb
State Highway Engineer ???
